record.title: Okiraku Ryoushu no Tanoshii Ryouchi Bouei ~Seisan-kei Majutsu de Na mo na Kimura wo Saikyou no Jousai Toshi ni~
record.description:
From Seven Seas:  
Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he’s considered a child prodigy. Until he displays the “Production Magic” skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace. With only his personal maid, his father’s butler, a knight, a rescued slave, the memories of his past life, and his “worthless” magic, can Van improve the fortunes of this little village and himself?

[Official Japanese](https://comic-gardo.com/episode/3269754496561190983)

record.title: Okiraku Ryoushu no Tanoshii Ryouchi Bouei: Seisan-kei Majutsu de Na mo Naki Mura o Saikyou no Jousai Toshi ni (Novel)
record.description:
From Seven Seas:  
Van, fourth son of a marquis, is just a toddler when he realizes he’s been reincarnated. Thanks to his literal lifetime of knowledge, he’s raised as a child prodigy. Until his production magic manifests, and it’s the last thing his snooty mage family wants to see! His disappointed father banishes him to a podunk town on the verge of collapse, yet Van can only see the place’s potential. Can our hero’s bastion of battlements build a better life than battle magic ever could?

record.title: Daites Ryou Koubouki
record.description:
From [Endless Journey](https://www.mangaupdates.com/groups.html?id=10552):

Milliana, the daughter of a duke in some remote region, used to enjoy a fujoshi lifestyle in her previous life in modern Japan. However, living in another world is pretty inconvenient., and on top of that, there are no BL books! Aiming for moe and pleasant life - including iron manufacture, communication, papermaking, and printing techniques - she begins a period of technological reformation! However, the Black Demon General Matisa busts in to her life as the groom. With a bride who can freely use contemporary technology and a groom who unfolds her otherworldly cheat-like ability, here is the long-awaited unique reincarnation fantasy manga adaptation!

[Original Webcomic](https://www.alphapolis.co.jp/manga/official/725000154)  
[Original Web Novel](https://www.alphapolis.co.jp/book/detail/1043151/1131)

Note: The author of the source novel passed away in a traffic accident in August 2017, leaving the source material for the manga incomplete. Vol 8 of the light novel was the last release, in June 2017. Vol 8's synopsis suggests the story was still meant to continue.

record.title: Ryoushu no Kuchizuke
record.description: When Tessa hears from her mother, who left when Tessa was only five years old, it’s a dream come true. She hurries off to the French countryside to see her mother for the first time in twenty years. But when she arrives, she finds a letter addressed to her: her mother had to flee from loan sharks, and she’s leaving her rental cottages in Tessa’s care! Confused, Tessa tries to get an answer out of Guy de Turaine, her mother’s landlord, only to find out that the villagers hate her mother. To make matters worse, now that he knows she’s her daughter, his gaze has gone ice cold!

record.title: Revenge Daitouryou Goei
record.description:
On January 20, 2033, at 12:20 PM , the 49th President of the United States (White House), Liam  is at the inauguration ceremony in Washington DC. During the inauguration speech of President Liam, his bodyguard, an SS(Secret Service ) named Souta who is known as "Aegis, the Shield of God" is by his side. Amid the speech, a terrorist attack targeting the President occurs. Souta uses his exceptional skills and successfully saves the President from the explosion but fails to prevent the next attack and tragically dies in explosion.  However, when Souta wakes up, he finds himself back in his high school days... The story begins with the high school student with the strongest physical abilities , embarking on a thrilling action packed journey to restart his new life.

record.title: Ryoushu-sama no Hana Yome
record.description: A ceremony joins two people from different classes in marriage. Ao is a lonely young man who grew up with wealth. Shion is a boy who grew up surrounded by a loving family. As children, Ao and Shion believed they could stay together despite their different backgrounds... but as they grew up into adults, Ao became the lord of the land, and they grew apart. As fate would have it, it turns out their ancestors were bound through a "binding ceremony," and now it's their turn. The ceremony is only for show? or at least that's what Shion initially thinks. Even though he won't admit it, his heart races on their first night as a wedded couple. And the ceremony won't end until they consummate the marriage. Shion tries to resist, but in the end, he lets Ao have his way with him...! They come from different classes and backgrounds, but their love begins with a ceremony that started way back with their ancestors. Perhaps someday Shion will understand why Ao chose him.

record.title: Ryoushukan no America-jin
record.description: Saul Bradford believed that Lucy Martin bore him a grudge for turning her out of her father's house -- she was well aware of that. Yet how could she resent him when she had helped to make him so unhappy in the past? She only wanted to atone for her bad behaviour by making him welcome to the manor, and by shielding him from her cousin Neville's sarcastic tongue. But Saul wasn't inclined to accept her protection ? he made it perfectly clear that wasn't what he wanted at all!
